_note: Target bands for the balance loop (tools/tune/check.mjs). Only change them after the user agrees. A metric scores 0 inside its band; outside, it scores weight x relative distance to the nearest edge.

skills._why: Each attack skill's value (damage per energy, single + cluster/3) compared to the median of the other attack skills of the same tier across all heroes. Utility skills (control, mobility, defense) are not scored.

bossTime._why: Seconds to kill each boss with an immortal good bot on Normal (pure damage check, per hero, averaged over the 4 starting elements).

bossTimeSpread._why: Slowest hero / fastest hero boss kill time (S5 + S10). Keeps the four heroes close in damage.

progress._why: Mean progress (stage reached + fraction of boss HP removed) of the good bot on Normal, per hero.

progressSpread._why: Best hero / worst hero progress for the good bot on Normal. Plan: heroes within 15%.

brutal._why: Brutal progress / Normal progress for the good bot, all heroes pooled. Brutal should be 40-60% harder (user, 2026-11-28).

skillGap._why: Good bot progress / novice bot progress on Normal, all heroes pooled. Easy to play, hard to master: practice must pay off. Off for now (weight 0): the good bot is not reliably better than the novice bot yet, so this measures the bot, not the game.
